concerns.text: FR-001 requires downloading SWE-bench and AgentBench subsets. Task T010 implements the download logic, but T011 is marked [X] (complete) while T010 is [ ] (incomplete). T011 describes 'code artifact extraction logic' which logically depends on the data being downloaded by T010. The current state implies T011 is complete without T010, creating a logical impossibility for the ground truth generation required by FR-001 and US-1.

FR-004 and US-3 require training a model. Task T028 (Implement train_model.py) is marked [ ] (incomplete), yet T029 (Implement Logistic Regression/RF) and T031 (Sensitivity analysis) are marked [X] (complete). T029 and T031 describe implementation details that must reside within the script defined in T028. The plan shows the implementation of the model logic as complete while the script creation task is missing, breaking the traceability for FR-004.

FR-006 requires framing correlations as associational. Task T035 generates the report and includes the 'associational' statement, but T035 depends on T031 and T032. T031 and T032 are marked [X], but T028 (the script containing the logic) is [ ]. If T028 is not implemented, the logic for T031/T032/T035 cannot exist, leaving FR-006 unimplemented.

Task T040 references validating 'quickstart.md'. The plan.md lists 'quickstart.md' as a Phase 1 output, but there is no task in Phase 1 (Setup or Foundational) that explicitly creates or writes 'quickstart.md'. T040 is a validation task for an artifact that has no creation task in the plan, creating a coverage gap for the plan element 'quickstart.md'.

Task T004 requires creating 'structural_metric.schema.yaml' with specific fallback logic. While T004 is marked [X], the task description is the only place this requirement is captured. There is no separate task or sub-task explicitly verifying that the generated schema file actually implements the conditional logic for 'semantic_complexity_score' vs fallback metrics as required by FR-002. The coverage relies entirely on the description of T004 being sufficient, which is risky for a schema validation requirement.
